title:
Epic to close alerts on {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} or {@link SensorHealthAlert}.
Accepts the type of alert to be closed in the payload parameter 'typeName' and filters out already closed alerts,(if any)
before closing selected alerts.

Additionally:
- The last triggered action for this Epic will be a: `${gridId}.CLOSE_BATCH_ALERT_EPIC_FINISHED` action.

This epic should be re-usable to close alerts of any other type, as long as 'Closed' is the state representing closeness of the alert.

This epic manages alerts with and without feedback. If an alert doesn't have feedback, it should include a "excludeFeedback" parameter in the payload with value "true". Otherwise, if it has feedback, no changes are needed, just use the function as it is.
name: UiSdlEpicCloseBatchAlerts
